title: French Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired lamb stew recipe, perfect for a cold evening. This dish combines the rich flavors of lamb with the comfort of a classic French stew.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the pot and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the lamb in the oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Strain the sauce and serve it over the lamb and vegetables.
